name: Warehouse — Energy Management
tagline: Keep the shift running without exhausting the battery.
narrative:
The night-shift route now has a 60-unit battery and a charging bay. Pickup, delivery, and navigation already work.

The robot still cannot finish all six orders if it runs out of energy. It must recognise a low battery at the charging bay and recharge before continuing the route.
objective: Deliver all station orders while managing the robot's finite battery.
learningObjective: Use a changing resource level to interrupt routine work safely.
intelligenceExplanation:
The existing policy can fulfil orders, but it does not protect the battery. Add a charging rule for the low-energy case at the charging station.

Place that maintenance rule above navigation. Charging only works on the charging tile and restores the configured battery capacity, so charging too late leaves work unfinished.
hint: Add `chargingHere && energy < 40 → charge` and place it above the clear-aisle movement rule.
hints: The robot passes the charger once per aisle loop; charging anywhere else is impossible.
Combine chargingHere with a numeric energy threshold so the robot does not charge on every visit.
Use WHEN chargingHere AND energy < 40 → charge, positioned before the navigation rules.
brief: Complete the six-order shift without exhausting the robot's battery.
context: The existing fulfilment policy works, but every action now consumes energy and one route tile is a charger.

steps.label: Recharge at the charging station before energy runs out

states.description: Operate the route and maintain the battery.
